# Hermes Agent: FAQ & Onboarding Guide

### 1. Installation & Platforms

**Q: Is native Windows supported?**  
Yes. Windows 10/11 is a Tier 1 supported platform using PowerShell (`install.ps1`). WSL2 is recommended only if you require the web dashboard's embedded POSIX terminal (`/chat`).

**Q: Does Docker support ARM64 / NAS setups?**  
Yes. Official images (`nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest`) are multi-arch (`linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`). For NAS permissions (UGOS, Synology, unRAID), pass `PUID` and `PGID` (or `HERMES_UID`/`HERMES_GID`) to remap container permissions.

**Q: Can Hermes run on Android (Termux)?**  
Yes. The installer detects Termux automatically, configures `$TMPDIR`, and installs the curated `[termux-all]` package bundle.

**Q: Is there a Web UI?**  
Run `hermes dashboard` to launch the local web interface and chat UI at `http://127.0.0.1:9119`.

---

### 2. Models & Providers

**Q: Why are small local models (Ollama/Qwen 4B–9B) slow?**  
Hermes sends the complete tool schema (~45 tools) on each turn. To optimize speed:
- Disable unused tools using `hermes tools`.
- Use faster quantization or larger models (32B+).
- Set `terminal.backend: local` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml` to avoid container overhead.

**Q: Why does Hermes ignore my local `base_url`?**  
`provider: auto` prioritizes remote API keys found in environment variables. Force local routing by setting `provider: custom` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`.

**Q: How do I use Claude Pro/Max subscription allowances?**  
Anthropic bills API keys per token. To use subscription usage, authenticate using Claude OAuth instead of an API key.

**Q: How do I configure Azure Foundry and Ollama Cloud?**  
- **Azure Foundry**: Set `provider: azure-foundry` and export `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL` (or run `hermes setup`).
- **Ollama Cloud**: Set provider to `ollama-cloud` (connects via `https://ollama.com/v1`).

**Q: How do I enable vision for custom models?**  
Add `supports_vision: true` to the model entry in your configuration.

**Q: Can Hermes auto-route simple prompts to cheap models?**  
No. By policy, Hermes enforces primary session consistency and does not support automated tier routing (`smart_model_routing`). Switch manually via `/model` or configure subagents in `delegation.model`.

---

### 3. Messaging Gateways & Personas

**Q: How do I configure Discord, Telegram, or other messaging channels?**  
Run `hermes gateway setup` to launch the interactive platform setup wizard.

**Q: Why does Telegram report "Unauthorized user"?**  
`allowed_chats` only filters group IDs. For DM access, add your numeric user ID under `allow_from` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml` or run `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>`.

**Q: Can gateways exchange files and images?**  
Yes. Inbound files (`.py`, `.txt`, etc.) are injected into context or cached. Outbound files and media are dispatched natively across platforms (Matrix `m.file`, email attachments, DingTalk Markdown `![image](url)`, Telegram media, and MCP `MEDIA:<path>` tags).

**Q: How do multi-agent delegation and per-channel personas work?**  
- **Per-Channel Persona**: Set `channel_prompts` per channel ID in platform configs.
- **Multi-Profile Gateways**: Run multiplexed gateways with isolated sessions and memory per profile.
- **Multi-Agent Execution**: Use the `delegate_task` tool to spawn isolated child `AIAgent` instances.

---

### 4. Memory, Execution & Autonomy

**Q: What are `SOUL.md`, `USER.md`, and `MEMORY.md`?**  
- `~/.hermes/SOUL.md`: Persona and system instructions.
- `~/.hermes/USER.md`: User identity, preferences, and facts (`target="user"`).
- `~/.hermes/MEMORY.md`: Long-term global memory.

**Q: How do I add custom memory providers or tools?**  
In-tree additions to `plugins/memory/` are closed. Add memory providers or tools as standalone plugins inside `~/.hermes/plugins/` and enable them via `hermes plugins enable <name>`.

**Q: What happens when the agent hits turn limits?**  
Sessions default to 90 turns (`agent.max_turns`). When hit, the agent finalizes without additional tool calls. For persistent, long-running tasks, run `/goal <task>` (Ralph loop) and resume with `/goal resume`. Crash-interrupted sessions can be continued with `/resume`.

---

### 5. Diagnostics & Observability

- **Doctor Check**: Run `hermes doctor` to validate environment, configs, and dependencies.
- **Skill Usage**: Check skill execution stats via `/insights` or `hermes insights`.
- **Tracing**: Enable Langfuse tracing via `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse`.
- **Security Vulnerabilities**: Report privately via GitHub Security Advisories or email `security@nousresearch.com`.
